proposed_sampling.basis: Finite one-candidate, one compatible producer/protocol/context-bucket pass. These are ceilings, not a claim that the budget achieves admission. No automatic top-up. Failures and unknowns consume the same cumulative budget. First two samples of each task form a diagnostic batch before the rest.

admission_math.medium_scored: 8 is only the quantity floor; at 8 samples the conservative mean lower endpoint must reach at least 0.90 with no variance to pass 0.75.
admission_math.high_scored: 20 cannot pass 0.85 even at a perfect score because the penalty is 0.20. 36 is the theoretical first possible passing size at perfect independent scores; realistic results may remain insufficient. Stop and report, do not sample until PASS.
admission_math.medium_binary: At least 11 correct independent samples in each PASS and FAIL stratum are necessary under the current Wilson/penalty floor. 22 assumes distinct samples for each stratum.
admission_math.high_binary: At least 23 correct independent samples in each PASS and FAIL stratum; 46 assumes distinct samples. Actual legitimate labels must determine strata, not manufactured negatives.
admission_math.evidence_deduplication: Native retry, duplicate input or duplicate normalized content is not an independent sample. Exact producer, risk, protocol and context bucket must agree.

human_workload.dimension_level_records: Each sampled task uses every frozen task dimension; actual annotation count exceeds sample count. Cannot replace humans with model consensus.
human_workload.estimated_hours: UNKNOWN; agree after blinded two-sample pilot

proposed_production.basis: Bounded same-Book realization, accepted continuation, one future replan, one edition validation and screenplay update. Actual chapters are determined by behavior coverage. No guarantee that this ceiling completes production.
proposed_production.phase_accounting: Freeze per native scope before send; phase totals may not exceed the listed overall task ceilings. All monetary/entitlement caps still require user input.

effect_validation.protocol_required_before_first_compariso: Freeze hypotheses, exact legal baselines, grouping, sample independence, one changed factor, cost/latency, craft/character/review quality and continue-reading measures.
effect_validation.initial_comparison_scope: 2 independent short narrative decision windows per approved factor; no Cartesian product, no million-word extrapolation.
effect_validation.participant_identity: Actual independent readers; separate from generator and model evaluator identities

freeze_before_dispatch: exact accepted source edition and input hashes
task-scoped model admissions for every arm
separate finite effect-experiment campaign and per-arm native grants
actual participant identities and concealed A/B assignment seed
prespecified_design.unit_of_analysis: One independently authored narrative decision window; repeated judgments and native retries are not independent samples.

factors.hypothesis: A compatible optional second Card improves located causal or spatial clarity without forced explanation or weakening the primary Card.
factors.control: Same v4 mandatory primary Card and accepted phase; optional secondary Card omitted under its approved abstention policy.
factors.treatment: Same primary plus the selector-approved compatible secondary Card at its validated scene position.
factors.changed_factor: Optional compatible composition only; no mandatory requirement or phase gate removed.

factors.hypothesis: An additional justified private lookahead step preserves unfinished commitments without unnatural action or knowledge leakage.
factors.control: Current v3 bounded two-step intent with all commitments and necessary private facts retained.
factors.treatment: Current v3 intent with one additional legal lookahead step; same current action opportunity.
factors.changed_factor: Bounded lookahead horizon; both contracts and producer variants require explicit compatibility/admission.

factors.hypothesis: A governed paired accepted-prose window reduces missed continuity errors without increasing false positives, over-editing or new contradictions.
factors.control: Current legal local review path with the same mandatory accepted fact/knowledge/permission constraints.
factors.treatment: Same reviewer and revision policy with the admitted cross-window prose evidence.
factors.changed_factor: Permitted review prose window; if the current frozen policy requires the window, this pair is ineligible rather than bypassing it.

prespecified_design.stage_continuity_measure: Within the same admitted production chain, inspect located CONTINUE and justified ADVANCE observations, interruptions and costs. Without a separately admitted phase-only control, report this as descriptive evidence and do not claim an isolated causal phase benefit.
shared_constraints: same original brief and exact accepted source
same task model and reasoning settings
same maximum native budget and recovery rules
prespecified_design.allocation: Separate effect-only campaign: 3 factors × 2 independent decision-window pairs × 2 arms = 12 arms, each at most 2 sequential native windows. No Cartesian product. These calls are additional to the separately bounded same-Book production request; no transfer between pools.
prespecified_design.blinding: Use the existing blind-pack exporter and native human/reference registration. Conceal model identity, intervention label and generated ordering; retain the original concealed mapping for authorized audit. No model-filled human fields.
outcomes: paired reader preference and continuation willingness
located promise continuity and knowledge-boundary violations
unchanged-range preservation and actual repair success
input/output tokens, wall latency, revision counts, failures and UNKNOWN cost/receipts
prespecified_design.analysis: Publish each pair and each independent reader response, denominators, disagreement, abstention and missing data. Report ordinal paired differences and raw failure counts; two pairs cannot establish broad statistical benefit. Model judgments remain a separate proxy source.
prespecified_design.stopping: Stop the affected scope at any source/permission/knowledge contamination, unknown external result, contract drift or exhausted reservation. Stop expansion after inconclusive or adverse pilot results; retain all negatives and propose adjustment or non-use without sampling to PASS.
prespecified_design.extrapolation: No inference beyond the observed windows; no million-word stability or universal quality claim.

proposed_budget.source_condition: Reuse exact legally available accepted source and native dependencies already established by production. If an arm needs new source preparation or a new incompatible producer admission, stop that arm; no implicit extra calls or invented qualification.
proposed_budget.experimental_outputs: Remain governed experiment outputs and can never be promoted to the official manuscript or counted as production literary evidence; keep per-arm facts and acceptance lineage isolated.
proposed_budget.native_arm_binding: PENDING_EXACT_LEGAL_NATIVE_SOURCE_AND_CAMPAIGN_FREEZE; do not dispatch until replayable source/permission/acceptance boundaries and arm accounting are proven

human_workload.separate_adjudicator: One actual third participant for disputed located facts; reading preference is not adjudicated into a fabricated consensus

effect_validation.sample_independence: The 6 matched pairs are separate narrative decision-window sources; the 2 arms within a pair and each arm's 2 sequential windows are not independent samples. Repeated review or retries never increase the denominator.

stop_conditions: Missing or expired scoped authorization/account identity; no dispatch.
Producer/schema/Pack/contract drift: freeze the changed task only after compatibility recheck; do not copy qualification.
Unknown external outcome or unknown cost holds its original task/campaign budget until native reconciliation; unrelated authorized scopes remain independent.
Any task, campaign, token, amount, entitlement or expiry ceiling reached: stop that scope; no automatic top-up.
Source/edition mismatch, knowledge leak, Canon contamination or permission bypass: stop affected production.
Reference disagreement, poor quality, no measured benefit or insufficient coverage: retain negative evidence and report; do not manufacture labels or seek PASS with more samples.
